name: qfd_xs_leaf_w130m5-m5a-COMMIT
purpose: M5 re-kit of the w130 x leaf for the hierarchical Q-DV slice (heads / slice2 cluster child)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_xs_leaf #(.NCH(4), .READ_PIN_PIPE(1), .FILL_PIPE(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/dvm_20261014/ot_qfd_xslice.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_xs_leaf_w130m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_xs_leaf_w130m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_xs_leaf_w130m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_xs_leaf  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: QK-SLICE 10-18 M5 re-kit (S-QSLICE PARTITION: the w130 leaf is an M6 leaf -- E/W pins on M6, signals M2-M6 -- so child_lint (c) FAILs under any parent with M6 straps; coordinator 0gs(c) makes the slice a hardened cluster in the die's M1-M7 grant: children M5, straps M6, PG M7). Same RTL / params (NCH 4, READ_PIN_PIPE 1, FILL_PIPE 1), outline 129.6 x 69.12, N/S pins unchanged (M3 / M5, same x per bit); the 791 E/W pins move M6 -> M4 at the nearest M4 track to the same y (443 E / 348 W on 69.12 um = 6.4 / 5.0 per um, as w130). Cap M5, PG M5 stripes; no M6 stub / grant. 0 cycles.
